scope: three-level accumulated ItemRepair.DIRPF 0.2/0.7/1 across a predeclared 48-seed native panel

source.interpretation: The native engine draws a direct-repair complexity for each failed item and compares it to each station's accumulated DIRPF. The easiest 0.2 can repair at BASE-01; the next 0.5 at DEPOT-01; the remaining 0.3 at WORKSHOP-01, whose top-level fraction is 1.0.

model_delta.common: From accepted E06.var01 upstream arm: base DIRPF 0→0.2; depot DIRPF 1→0.7; append WORKSHOP-01 station, DEPOT-01→WORKSHOP-01 two-hour FAST support link, ItemRepair DIRPF1/DIRPT1 row, and zero workshop stock. Extend simulation, Control report, and both ResultCollection mission/system horizons 36→60 hours to observe terminal return after third-wave failures. Retain all E05 aircraft, missions, failure rate, local spare and two-hour BASE→DEPOT transport.
model_delta.per_seed: Control.RSEED is the sole difference among seeds 1 through 48.

predeclared_native_acceptance: All 48 predeclared seed inputs must be generated from the frozen builder, match their manifest SHA-256, import/export all populated business rows exactly, convert with zero errors and complete native calculation/report with nonempty logs and 120 aligned half-hour System and Stock bins.

For every observed removed LRU with a direct-repair complexity, trace its physical identity, station path, timed transport, repair start/completion, return to BASE-01 stock, associated system demand and mission impact. Local repairs must have complexity below 0.2, depot repairs between 0.2 and 0.7, and final workshop repairs at or above 0.7; no item may be counted twice or disappear.

At least 36 of 48 runs must contain an observed first failed-item direct-repair complexity, and first-failure routing must include at least three runs at each of the three levels. The observed sample frequencies are descriptive; no population probability or random-generator law is accepted from this panel.

Source and installed executable/manual/dictionary hashes must remain stable through each session-0 SSH run under the host-wide native queue while GUI PID 13340 remains responsive. Preserve immutable raw run directories and SHA-256 closures, then obtain separate read-only independent replay.
limits: The 48-seed panel tests observed threshold classification and route conservation at these fractions, not exact 20/50/30 population frequencies or distributional independence.
SURPF, CMF, partial discard/DISCF, PRU/DU categories, multiple bases, resource contention, GUI visual behavior and cross-engine equivalence remain separate scopes.

diagnostic_predecessor.reason: Inherited ResultCollection mission/system RCEND=36 while Control SIMPE/RCEND=60; system bins therefore stopped at 36 hours and failed the predeclared 120-bin acceptance. Raw local 48-seed diagnostic runs are preserved under the predecessor candidate.
